title: Candle (OHLCV bar)
description: One OHLCV bar. Declared in backend/api/internal/markets/overview/market.go Candle with every field a decimal string and 'an unreported volume is empty, not zero'. NO STORE EXISTS: there is no candle table in database/ (grep `candle` over database/ returns none), so bars are read live per request and never persisted. The bar series identity is (instrument, interval, open_time) - the Go field Interval is documented as 'the venue bar size (e.g. 1m), identity of the bar series'.

interval.description: Venue bar size; the TS allowlist is TICKER_TIMEFRAMES = ['1m','5m','15m','1h','4h','1d','1w'] (frontend/web/src/features/ticker/client.ts), max 500 bars per request.

volume.description: Null when unreported - never 0 ('unreported volume is empty, not zero').
